name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Shardstorm SH-3 'Glassbreaker'
description:
A heavy electromagnetic scatter cannon that fires frangible Ablonite-KR ceramic slugs which fragment into razor-edged shards upon exiting the barrel. The Shardstorm uses a linear electromagnetic accelerator to propel a solid ceramic cylinder through a rifled fracture sleeve — a barrel section machined with internal stress-inducing ridges that shatter the slug into a predictable cloud of fragments while imparting a rotational spread pattern.

The SH-3 occupies a middle ground between conventional shotguns and area-denial weapons. Each ceramic slug fragments into approximately 60 shards, each one hard enough to defeat soft body armor and sharp enough to cause catastrophic tissue damage. The Ablonite-KR ceramic is radar-transparent and produces no metallic signature, making the weapon's ammunition invisible to standard weapon-detection systems tuned for ferrous projectiles.

Arcturus developed the Shardstorm for operations in environments with dense electronic surveillance where conventional metallic ammunition would be detected in flight by tracking systems. The ceramic shards pass through standard bullet-trajectory sensors without registering, arriving at the target with no electronic warning. This capability has made the SH-3 extremely popular among operators who work in high-security zones where every fired round is tracked in real time.
legality: Restricted — ceramic ammunition classified as detection-evasive
specifications:
slug_type: Frangible Ablonite-KR ceramic cylinder
fragment_count: ~60 per slug
effective_range: 5-30 meters
rate_of_fire: 1 shot per 2.4 seconds (capacitor + autoloader)
capacity: 4-slug tubular magazine
weight: 5.6 kg
power_source: Dorsal capacitor, 20 shots per charge
detection_profile: Zero metallic signature
tactical_use: The Shardstorm is deployed in security-saturated environments where conventional ammunition would be tracked by real-time ballistic monitoring systems. Its ceramic shards are invisible to ferrous-detection grids, giving operators a crucial window of confusion during the initial engagement. The weapon's heavy recoil and low capacity make it unsuitable for sustained firefights — it is a first-strike tool designed to deliver devastating damage before the enemy understands what is hitting them.
cultural_context: The existence of detection-evasive ammunition has forced GLMZ's security infrastructure into an expensive upgrade cycle — and the security companies selling the upgrades are often subsidiaries of the same corporations selling the weapons that made the upgrades necessary. This feedback loop is not lost on the city's residents. The Shardstorm has become a symbol of corporate self-dealing: create the problem, sell the solution. Among operators, the weapon is respected for its technical elegance but disliked for its limited capacity.
story_hooks: Ablonite-KR ceramic shards have been found in a Tier 4 executive who supposedly died of natural causes — the shards are invisible to standard autopsy scanning and were only discovered by a persistent forensic pathologist using experimental imaging.
A black-market supplier is selling counterfeit Ablonite-KR slugs that fragment unpredictably — some operators have been injured by shards that ricocheted back from the fracture sleeve.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist electromagnetic scatter cannon with a pronounced angular aesthetic. The Shardstorm resembles a hybrid between a traditional shotgun and a scientific instrument—all hard edges, industrial geometry, and purposeful bulk. The rifled fracture sleeve barrel dominates the weapon's profile, visibly machined with internal stress-inducing ridges visible through the transparent breach housing. The overall impression is one of calculated violence: engineered, precise, and merciless.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 78 cm, barrel length 42 cm, width at receiver 8 cm, height with dorsal capacitor 12 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty and front-weighted—5.6 kg distributed toward the barrel assembly. Feels purposeful and grounded in the hand, with substantial recoil impulse. Despite the weight, the balance point is aggressive rather than comfortable, making it a weapon designed for controlled bursts rather than sustained handling.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite chassis with aluminum alloy receiver. The fracture sleeve barrel is precision-machined stainless steel with visible rifling geometry. Dorsal capacitor housing is carbon-fiber reinforced polymer.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray primary finish with brushed aluminum accents around the receiver and charging mechanism. The fracture sleeve barrel displays a darker burnished finish from repeated electromagnetic cycling. Wear reveals pale composite substrate beneath, creating natural battle-worn striations.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray with brushed aluminum accents, black polymer grip, and faint indigo LED indicators at the capacitor junction. The internal rifling of the fracture sleeve creates a subtle metallic gradient visible through the transparent breach.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured black polymer grip with vertical ridging for traction, designed to absorb recoil. Forward stock is wrapped in synthetic cord woven with conductive filament. The trigger guard is bare brushed aluminum—cold and utilitarian.
distinctive_features: Transparent ammunition breach housing revealing the fracture sleeve's internal stress ridges
Prominent dorsal capacitor housing with faint indigo charging indicators
Linear electromagnetic accelerator coils visible beneath the breech area
Integrated autoloader magazine tube with engraved capacity markings (4 slugs)
Rifled fracture sleeve barrel with precisely machined internal stress lines
Heat vents along the receiver sides—ceramic-lined for electromagnetic discharge dissipation
Arcturus Defense Solutions logo stamped on the receiver in metallic plate
Charge status window with capacitor voltage scale etched in Φ-currency denominations
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions hexagonal logo stamped in matte finish on the left receiver. Serial plate mounted below the breech with alphanumeric designation and manufacturing year (2224). 'SHARDSTORM SH-3' engraved in all-caps sans-serif font along the barrel shroud. Restricted ammunition warning symbol laser-etched on the magazine tube.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but meticulously maintained. The matte finish shows light scoring from tactical slings and environmental contact. The transparent breach housing often displays faint residue rings from ceramic fragmentation dispersal. The capacitor housing may show slight discoloration from electromagnetic cycling. Well-maintained examples appear almost surgical in their precision; heavily-used units develop a patina of use but retain mechanical integrity.
